newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks down sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks down sharply in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices plunged in late Friday trade as jitters over political instability triggered heavy selling, brokers said.
At 0245 GMT, with 75 minutes to go, the weighted index lost 181.56 points, or 2.17 percent, at 8,168.29. Turnover was T$62 billion.
"Political upheaval really worries people," said Albert Lin, research head of Golden Securities. "The resignation of Ma Ying-jeou is a big shock."

Ma, minister without portfolio and a popular politician, Interior Minister Lin Feng-cheng, and Tjiu Mau-ying, chairman of Taiwan's Council of Agriculture, tendered their resignations to Premier Lien Chan on Thursday.
The administration, which has faced intense criticism over a spate of violent crime, was expected to announce a reshuffle next week. Brokers said further falls were likely. -- Alice Hung (2-5080815)
